Article: (WIRED)Screens are rectangles. Even the 3-year-old playing with your iPad could tell you that. But what would the digital world look like through a different sort of frame? Summary: A Californian startup has developed a circular smartphone called "Runcible"
The provocative anti-phone is meant to be an antidote to our obsession for digital devices .
